title: The Telangana Disaster and Public Health Emergency (Special Provisions) Act, 2020
full_text: The Telangana Disaster and Public Health Emergency (Special Provisions) Act, 2020 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act Number: 14 Enactment Date: 2020-09-19 Act Year: 2020 Short Title: The Telangana Disaster and Public Health Emergency (Special Provisions) Act, 2020 Long Title: An Act to make special provision for the deferment of any payment in part, due and payable to any person, institution and any pay, pension and remuneration in part, to any employee, any pensioner and any other person, in the event of Disaster and Public Health Emergency in the State and for the matters connected therewith or incidental thereto. Department: Department of Finance Enforcement Date: 24-03-2020 Type: STATE Location: Telangana TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles Show all section Section 1. Short title, extent and commencement. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Power of the Government to defer the Payment, in part, due and payable to any person or institution. Section 4. Power of the Government to defer the pay in part due and payable to an employee employed by the Government and also pensioners and to any other person. Section 5. Power of the Government to defer the pay, in part, due and payable to an employee and pensioner of certain institutions including local self government institutions, statutory bodies etc., Section 6. Payment of deferred amount. Section 7. Power to make rules. Section 8. Power to remove difficulties. Section 9. Repeal of Ordinance No.2 of 2020.
